title: No Edges Within the Right Part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a Boolean matrix indexed by $\text{Fin}(n)\times\text{Fin}(n)$, and let $i,j\in\text{Fin}(n)$. In the bipartite graph specified by $A$, the right-part vertices indexed by $i$ and $j$ are not adjacent.
